metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 2020 · Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story
metas.description: The rise and fall of Harshad Mehta, a stockbroker who single-handedly took the stock market to great heights, is depicted.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2017 · Bose: Dead/Alive
metas.description: The man. The legend. The mystery. He fascinated us in life, and long after his "death". This is the story of India's biggest cover-up: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose and the mystery of his alleged death.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2023 · Scam 2003 - The Telgi Story
metas.description: Born in Khanapur in Karnataka, Telgi became the mastermind behind one of the most ingenious schemes in Indian history that spread across multiple states and shook the entire country.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2018 · Rangbaaz
metas.description: Rangbaaz Phir Se is inspired from the life of Anandpal Singh who was a gangster active in the state of Rajasthan. The series chronicles his rise to becoming the most wanted criminal in the history of Rajasthan.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2019 · Queen
metas.description: The Queen is a story of a woman in the male-driven worlds of Cinema and Tamil Nadu politics. It is a story of a woman who didn't get the happy ending she wanted and yet, was destiny's chosen child.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Scoop
metas.description: A journalist's life takes a 180 because of the very system that made her who she is. Will she fight or will she concede?
